_comment: Difficulty curve for tools/generate_levels.py. Nothing gets easier from one level to the next. Each stage runs up to level `to` with its wheel letters; its grid words grow from words[0] to words[1], and the next stage starts where this one ends. A grid word (and the full-length word) needs a frequency of at least minZipf, which drops from minZipf[0] at level 1 to minZipf[1] at the last level. Tune after playtests.
